defect_reasons.other: The base text states the car 'accelerates at a constant 2 m/s^2', so the R kit sentences (especially TE8F1, 'Before the start, a tuning kit added ...') admit a reading in which 2 m/s^2 is already the kit-inclusive acceleration (answer 15 s) rather than 3.3 m/s^2 (9.09 s).

notes: Certified answers verified: top speed 17 m/s gives 289/8 = 36.125 s, 21 m/s gives 441/24 = 18.375 s (both > v = 15 m/s so the car still catches up); K values 38, 46, 58 m/s all exceed a t = 30 m/s; extra acceleration 0.6, 1.3, 2.5 gives 30/2.6 = 11.5385, 30/3.3 = 9.0909, 30/4.5 = 6.6667 s. Minimal pairs T8C0C/TEA52 and T9424/TE8F1 share 1.3 m/s^2 and differ in attachment/timing; numeral-free twins match. Pass 1 rated the kit-wording issue low; on reflection, since the minimal-pair contrast T9424 vs TE8F1 rests entirely on the reader taking 'before the start' as a kit still fitted in this run and adding to the stated 2 m/s^2, I raise it to medium language ambiguity; the physics and numbers hold.
